independent_review.finding: The producer canonicalizes /lib64 loader paths to /usr/lib64 while the verifier requires the logical /lib64 path, so every real successful build is rejected. Synthetic tests hide the pinned image's /lib64 -> usr/lib64 mapping.
verified_improvements: Exact modes are applied and both profile modes are tested under umask 077.
Complete command/context/tool/source membership and negative mutations are implemented.
Generated diff retention and byte validation are present.
